parts:
Hello Stan users group,

We recently published a paper using (and citing) Stan. Would someone please enter it into mc-stan.org/citations?

Thanks

Tom

@article{Wallisetal:2014,
author = {Wallis, Thomas S A and Taylor, Christopher Patrick and Wallis, Jennifer and Jackson, Mary Lou and Bex, Peter J},
title = {{Characterization of field loss based on microperimetry is predictive of face recognition difficulties.}},
journal = {Investigative Ophthalmology {\&} Visual Science},
year = {2014},
volume = {55},
number = {1},
pages = {142--153}
}
